recipe.title: Italian Sausage and Peppers Skillet
recipe.summary: Lean Italian chicken sausage, peppers, and onions in a creamy Rao's tomato sauce finished with Parmesan.
recipe.story: A cozy skillet dinner with browned sausage, colorful peppers, and a creamy tomato sauce that gets extra protein from blended cottage cheese.
recipe.serving_size: 2 sliced sausage links with peppers, onions, and creamy tomato sauce
ingredients: 8 Al Fresco Sweet Italian Style Chicken Sausage links, sliced into rounds

ingredient_sections.title: Italian Sausage and Peppers Skillet
items: 8 Al Fresco Sweet Italian Style Chicken Sausage links, sliced into rounds

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and lightly coat with nonstick cooking spray.
Add the sliced Italian chicken sausage. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned around the edges.
Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add the bell peppers and onion to the same skillet. Cook for 5 to 6 minutes until softened but still slightly crisp.
Add the minced garlic, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 30 seconds.
Blend the Daisy cottage cheese and Rao's marinara sauce until completely smooth.
Reduce the skillet to medium-low heat and return the sausage to the pan.
Pour the creamy tomato sauce over the sausage and peppers and stir everything together.
Cook for another 2 to 3 minutes, just until the sauce is heated through. Do not boil the sauce.
Divide evenly among four servings and top each serving with 1 tablespoon Parmesan.
freezer_storage: Cool completely and divide into four freezer-safe containers.
reheating_instructions: Microwave for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, stir, then heat in 30-second increments until hot.
Alternatively, reheat gently in a covered skillet over medium-low heat.
tips: Blend the cottage cheese completely smooth before adding it to the skillet.
Keep the sauce below a boil so it stays creamy.
